whats_new:
The long-awaited version 2.0 release is now available. Although this update may appear incremental initially, it serves as a foundational release designed to support an expanded suite of features and enhancements in subsequent versions. Nevertheless, version 2.0 delivers significant upgrades.

Performance has been substantially enhanced. Internal benchmarks indicate up to a tenfold increase in execution speed in specific scenarios, driven by updated Python versions and the integration of more efficient, performance-critical APIs. Consequently, the user experience is noticeably smoother and more responsive.

The application footprint has been reduced by approximately 50% without compromising functionality.

The installer has been completely reengineered. It now supports both Arabic and English, features a redesigned user interface, and offers the capability to pre-download required components prior to the initiation of the installation process.

Media handling capabilities have also been improved. Users can now select a specific video quality prior to downloading. Additionally, a new optional background monitoring feature can detect YouTube links in the clipboard. Upon detection, the application will prompt the user to either download or play the content. This feature is disabled by default and can be enabled via the settings.

Regarding the settings panel, it has been expanded to include new options, such as default playback quality and controls for background monitoring.

Playback controls have been refined. Video speed can now be adjusted using the Shift + Up/Down Arrow key combination, replacing previous shortcuts. Speed increments are configurable within the settings, providing users with more precise control.

For advanced users, the application can now display the YouTube recommendations feed when user cookies are provided through the settings panel.

Finally, special acknowledgment is extended to Marwan Younis for testing and validating these improvements prior to release.

Further developments are forthcoming. This update establishes the foundation for future enhancements.
